designStyle.visualHierarchy: Clear, with larger, bolder text for titles and primary actions highlighted with accent colors. Information is grouped into distinct cards.

header.style: Dark background, centered title/subtitle, fixed to top.

searchBar.style: Rounded input field with a prominent, rounded accent-colored button.

navigationTabs.style: Segmented control, rounded corners, active state highlighted with accent color and bold text.

contentCard.style: Rectangular, white background, rounded corners, subtle drop shadow, contains an image, title, and description.
contentCard.layout: Vertical stacking of image, title, and description.

buttons.style: Rounded corners, solid fill for primary actions, text-only for secondary actions.

layoutPrinciples.gridSystem: Single-column layout optimized for mobile viewports.
layoutPrinciples.alignment: Elements generally left-aligned within their containers, with some text (e.g., button text) centrally aligned.
layoutPrinciples.responsiveness: Implied mobile-first design with vertical stacking and full-width elements (within padding).

otherAttributes.borderRadius: Consistent application of medium-sized rounded corners (e.g., 8px-12px) on cards, buttons, and input fields.
otherAttributes.shadows: Subtle, soft drop shadows applied to cards and interactive elements for depth.
otherAttributes.transitions: Likely smooth transitions for interactive states (e.g., button hovers, tab changes), though not visible in static image.
